secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL, e.g. https://<project>.supabase.co — Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API. A placeholder from .env.base44-defaults is used until you provide it, which leaves the catalog empty.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key — Project Settings → API. Needed for catalog data and login; the placeholder only allows the app to boot.
